body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and Suburban Directory for 1871.
A copy of the full directory is held by Melbourne History Resources, and you can read it online.

The 1871 directory has its own Carlton section, under North Melbourne (pp. 76–108), covering the area east of the Elizabeth-street extension between Victoria-street east and Reilly-street, as far east as Nicholson-street. It lists the streets in alphabetical order, each house by house, side by side, with the cross streets in order. Rathdowne and Berkeley streets are stored as Rathdown and Berkley streets to match the later years. A few residents printed under an unnamed right-of-way are kept with the street it runs off, with a note.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street, and only the listings inside it are kept here.
